footnotes: p. 79 n. 1 (mark after sen, end of F line 4): Var. em t'at'at àmt mitu kerḥ pui en àrit sàpt menta - set, "before the divine beings among the dead [on] night that of making judgment annihilated are they." See Naville, Todtenbuch, Bd. II., Bl. 79.
p. 79 n. 2 (mark after àmt, G line 1): Var. àm uat mita, "in the way of the dead."
p. 81 n. 1 (mark after āut, H line 2): Var. àbu.
p. 81 n. 2 (mark after àru, I line 2): Var. āā àru, "Mighty one of forms."
p. 81 n. 3 (mark after χepeś, I line 2): The papyrus of Nebseni adds t'at'a, "head."
notes: Boundaries match the brief: F = p.79 rows 1-5 (to sen); G = p.79 row 6 to p.80 row 7 (χefta - f); H = p.80 row 7 (§ H. 1. àr) to p.81 row 6, ending 'seśeta àru' (Budge prints àru with à, not āru); I = p.81 row 6 (§ I. 1.) to p.82 row 5 (χefta - f); J = p.82 row 5 (§ J. 1.) to p.83 last row 'ḥeḥ sep'. Line numerals: F 1-4; G 1-4 (G 2. inside Àsṭennu, p.80 row 1); H 1-4 (H 2. inside χeperu - sen, H 3. inside erṭāu - entu); I 1-4 (I 2. inside seśeta p.81 row 8); J 1-6 (J 2. before àb - f p.82 row 7, J 3. inside semaāχeru p.82 row 8, J 4. before āāt p.83 row 1, J 5. before ṭer - f p.83 row 3, J 6. before ṭāṭā p.83 row 5). Split groups keep the line at the first sign (F smaāχeru, F pui, G Àsṭennu, H χeperu - sen, H erṭāu - entu, I seśeta, J semaāχeru). Overlines (rubric): section heads F (àr...Abṭu), G (àr...mitu), H (whole p.80 row 8: àr t'at'at āāt àmt χebs - ta em Ṭeṭṭeṭu), I (àr...Naàrereṭef), J (àr t'at'at on p.82 row 5 continuing over āāt àmt Re - stau on row 6); short overlines over à before Teḥuti (p.79 r2, p.80 r3, p.81 r3, p.82 r1, p.82 r8); àr sàpt (p.80 r1) continuing over menti - sen (p.80 r2); àr kerḥ pui en (p.81 r7) continuing over seśeta àru (p.81 r8); the closing rubric from t'eṭtu re (p.83 r3) through every word of p.83 rows 4-8 to ḥeḥ sep. Budge prints wide blank spaces (no brackets, no signs) before χebs - ta on p.80 rows 5, 6, 8; English supplies '[the festival of]' there. No square brackets in the hieroglyph lines of these pages (no restorations); no (sic) or (?) printed. The running head of p.83 reads 'B.D. CHAP. XXIII.]' (apparently for XVIII). Recurring sign choices: blood det in senf (p.80 r7, p.81 r2) a zigzag rising to a cross with stem, coded M2 approx; the oblong rectangle open in the bottom line in Naàrereṭef and àterti coded O1; the hatched trapezoid coded W11 in kerḥ and T28 in χer (same printed shape); maāχeru after Ani printed Aa11 P8 without sickle; several semaāχeru without G43 (p.80 r3, r4, r7; p.82 r1, r2, r5).
